pairs.subject: media-playback
pairs.evidence: app/features/hiring/pipeline/useSchedulerControlState.ts:3 The context is an automation-scheduler control panel (polling a server schedule, manual tick, interval field, run history, liveness chip). A case-insensitive search of app/features/hiring/pipeline/ for playback, playhead, audio, HTMLMediaElement and <video found 0 hits, so none of the subject's preconditions applies: there is no app-owned media transport, no media engine, no composed media timeline and no media continuity. Its 'clock' is the automation tick loop, not a media playhead.
